methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Document360 and Guru publish no self-serve USD prices — all plans require a sales quote; recorded as null/custom. Helpjuice prices confirmed on official pricing page (3 flat-rate plans). Slab prices from official pricing page — annual rates ($6.67 and $12.50/user/month) confirmed; the official page publishes only annual per-user rates, so per-user monthlyUsd for Startup and Business is null (the previously-recorded $12 and $25/user/month monthly figures could not be confirmed by any credible source). Notion USD prices sourced from softwareadvice.com (official page renders EUR for this environment); Plus $12/$10 and Business $24/$18 per user per month confirmed. Nuclino prices from softwareadvice.com (official page renders without price values for this environment); Starter $6, Business $10 per user per month confirmed via getapp.com. Slite prices (Basic $10, Pro $20/user/month billed annually) confirmed on official page; monthly-only rate not published. Tettra prices ($8/user/month, 10-user minimum) confirmed on official page with 20% annual discount. Slashdot.org and softwareadvice.com used as corroboration sources where available. All accessedAt dates set to 2026-06-14.
